fix: read multi-digit and spaced slice bounds when substituting slice params (#179)

extractSliceParams substitutes $param slice bounds with a constant before
parsing, because groq-js only parses a slice whose bounds are constants.
Its pattern accepted a single digit for a literal bound and no whitespace
inside the brackets, so a defineQuery such as *[_type == "post"][10...$end]
or *[ $from .. $to ] failed typegen with "slicing must use constant
numbers". Both forms now parse; the cases that parsed before are unchanged.
